nodes.label: Morphological annotation
nodes.rationale: Annotations capture POS, grammatical features, and metadata so tokens can be analyzed incrementally rather than requiring a complete parse on first pass.

nodes.label: Local database backup files
nodes.rationale: Each backup is a full local .db copy plus .json metadata so work is protected without cloud storage; older copies are deleted once retention is reached.

nodes.label: Export glossary
nodes.rationale: Glossary entries are grouped by normalized root plus POS so unique lemmas collapse, while display keeps an original root form and merged senses.

nodes.label: Idiom annotation
nodes.rationale: A multi-word span gets its own annotation record when meaning or grammatical function belongs to the phrase as a whole, while word-level morphology can still be inspected separately.

nodes.label: Undo model
nodes.rationale: Editor operations are undoable, but project-level destructive actions such as deleting a project are not; backups and JSON export are the safety net for those.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL locking
nodes.rationale: WAL allows concurrent access, but multiple app instances can still lock the database, so extra instances should be closed.

nodes.label: Preterite-present requires infinitive shortcut
nodes.rationale: Selecting verb class preterite-present auto-enables Requires Infinitive because those verbs typically govern an infinitive complement, while still allowing a later manual override.

nodes.label: Root and surface-form normalization
nodes.rationale: Roots and surface forms are stored lowercase, without combining-mark diacritics or internal hyphens, with eth mapped to thorn, so grouping and search can match variant spellings while preserving OE letters.

nodes.label: Backup before migrations and restore
nodes.rationale: Backups run on a schedule and also immediately before schema migrations and restore operations so a failed upgrade can roll back to a known-good database.

nodes.label: LaTeX PDF pipeline
nodes.rationale: PDF is generated with a LaTeX-based layout so print output can use real footnotes, landscape columns, and a glossary rather than a simple text dump.

nodes.label: Phrase-level POS choice
nodes.rationale: Idiom POS should match the role of the full expression in context, not merely the head word; ambiguous cases use Alternatives, lower Confidence, and TODO.

nodes.label: Last-used POS values
nodes.rationale: The modal restores last-used values per POS type so similar tokens can be annotated quickly by changing only the fields that differ.

nodes.label: Incremental annotation philosophy
nodes.rationale: Old English annotation is iterative: all fields are optional so annotators can start with POS, add morphology later, and record alternatives instead of forcing a single guess.

nodes.label: Hide note superscripts while editing OE
nodes.norm_label: hide note superscripts while editing oe
nodes.rationale: Superscripts are hidden in OE edit mode so the editable text stays clean; ranges are automatically expanded, shrunk, or deleted when words change.

nodes.label: Compact JSON export
nodes.rationale: Null and schema-default fields are omitted so files stay small; import reconstructs omitted fields from schema defaults, and gzip is optional for smaller backups.

nodes.label: Import name collision suffix
nodes.rationale: If an imported project name already exists, a numeric suffix is added so the existing project is not overwritten.

nodes.label: Exact surface-text matching
nodes.rationale: Remembered entries match case-sensitive, diacritic-sensitive exact token text so reuse stays precise; they are token-only and do not store idiom annotations or per-instance sense.

nodes.label: Project scope overrides global
nodes.rationale: When global and project remembered annotations exist for the same exact token text, the project entry wins so a single text can override a shared template.

nodes.label: Skip already filled annotations
nodes.rationale: Batch apply skips tokens that already contain meaningful annotation data so existing work is not overwritten; the apply is a single undoable batch.

nodes.label: OE search normalization
nodes.rationale: OE-aware search normalizes queries the same way stored roots are normalized so partial matches can ignore diacritics, hyphens, and eth/thorn variation.

nodes.label: Settings outside editor undo
nodes.rationale: Settings changes are not on the editor undo stack, so Ctrl+Z cannot revert them; values must be changed back in Preferences.

nodes.label: Theme change requires restart
nodes.rationale: Theme is saved immediately but applied only after a full quit and relaunch because the UI theme cannot switch live.

nodes.label: Manual translation scaffold
nodes.rationale: The app does not auto-translate or auto-annotate; it is an efficiency scaffold so a human translator can organize linguistic decisions.
